body:
@cgoller Thank you for opening the issue.

I can confirm the bug. Indeed, `analysis.analyzer.default_search` index setting is not applied during search for a field `body_default` as it is supposed to.

issue.title: Restore use of default search and search_quote analyzers

labels.name: :Search Foundations/Mapping
labels.description: Index mappings, including merging and defining field types

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
In the refactoring of TextFieldMapper, we lost the ability to define
a default search or search_quote analyzer in index settings.  This
commit restores that ability, and adds some more comprehensive
testing.

Fixes #65434
